import json, statistics

print(f'Det SFT steps: {det_steps}')
print(f'Tie steps (excluded): {tie_steps}')
print(f'Internal label ratio: {int_steps}/{int_steps+det_steps+0.001:.0f} = {int_steps/(int_steps+det_steps+0.001)*100:.1f}%')
